# TrueMapData (truemapdata)

> Python library and CLI for TrueMap v6 and GelSight TMD height maps: I/O, surface processing, visualization, texture map export, and 3D mesh generation. Python 3.8+. Package name on PyPI: `truemapdata`. Console script: `tmd-process`.

## Project & install

- [README (overview, CLI, format notes)](https://github.com/ETSTribology/TrueMapData/blob/main/README.md)
- [pyproject.toml (dependencies, scripts, tooling)](https://github.com/ETSTribology/TrueMapData/blob/main/pyproject.toml)
- [requirements.txt](https://github.com/ETSTribology/TrueMapData/blob/main/requirements.txt)
